# SCRIPE — Ultimate Understand-Anything Super Atlas (All-in-One Master Hub)

> **Single-Place Master Reference** uniting every capability of `/understand`, `/understand-domain`, `/understand-knowledge`, `/understand-onboard`, `/understand-explain`, `/understand-diff`, `/understand-chat`, and `/understand-dashboard` across **100% of `SCRIPE-Backend`**, **`SCRIPE-Frontend`**, **`SCRIPE/wiki`**, and the **Full-Stack Monorepo**.

---

## 1. All 5 Live Interactive Web Portals (`/understand-dashboard`)

| Port | Portal Name | Direct URL | Nodes & Edges | Layers & Guided Tour | Domain & Flow Graph |
|---:|---|---|---|---|---|
| **5177** | **Unified Super Command Center (All-in-One Hub)** | **[http://127.0.0.1:5177](http://127.0.0.1:5177)** | All 18 Modules + All 4 Live Graphs + 36 Wiki Articles | 7 Interactive Tabs + Instant Symbol Search | Full 18-Domain & 36-Flow Explorer |

| **5175** | **Full-Stack Monorepo Merged Dashboard** | **[http://127.0.0.1:5175/?token=scripe](http://127.0.0.1:5175/?token=scripe)** | **`25,504` nodes** · **`71,683` edges** | **`38` Layers** · **`38`-Step Tour** | **`18` Domains · `36` Flows · `144` Steps** |
| **5176** | **`SCRIPE-Frontend` Next.js 16 MVVM Dashboard** | **[http://127.0.0.1:5176/?token=scripe](http://127.0.0.1:5176/?token=scripe)** | **`9,269` nodes** · **`18,142` edges** | **`16` MVVM Layers** · **`16`-Step Tour** | **`14` Frontend Domains · `14` MVVM Flows · `56` Steps (`84` nodes, `94` edges)** |

---

| **Background Jobs & Seeders** | **68 / 133** | Hangfire `IAutoRegisteredJob` recurring workers & UAT Permission/Feature/Menu/Data seeders |

# SCRIPE-Backend — Super Onboarding Bible (/understand-onboard)

> **Role-Tailored Engineering Onboarding Guide** covering all **18 Backend Modules**, **Core Kernel**, **Host.API**, **AstraFlow 2.2.0**, and **Dual-Mode Multi-DB Persistence**.

---

## 1. Day-1 Mental Model: How SCRIPE-Backend Works

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    HTTP["HTTP Request + Bearer JWT"] --> Host["Scripe.Host.API (Program.cs)"]
    Host --> Auth["JWT + TenantContext + PBAC Policy"]
    Auth --> Ctrl["Module Controller (src/Modules/{Module}/...Infrastructure/Controllers)"]
    Ctrl --> Med["AstraFlow ISender.Send(Command / Query)"]
    Med --> Pipe["ValidationBehavior -> Logging -> Performance -> Transaction"]
    Pipe --> Handler["ICommandHandler / IQueryHandler (Returns Result<T>)"]
    Handler --> Db["ModuleDbContext (Isolated Schema + Tenant Query Filter)"]
    Db --> Outbox["SaveChangesAsync + OutboxMessage in Same DB Transaction"]
    Outbox --> Worker["OutboxProcessor (Background Job) -> INotificationHandler"]
```

### The 5 Golden Laws of SCRIPE-Backend
1. **3-Project Module Isolation**: Every module in `src/Modules/{Module}/` has strictly three projects:
   - `Scripe.Module.{Module}.Domain` — Entities (`AuditableEntity`), Value Objects, Domain Events (`INotification`), Specifications. Zero infrastructure dependencies.
   - `Scripe.Module.{Module}.Application` — Commands (`ICommand<T>`), Queries (`IQuery<T>`), Handlers, Validators (`AbstractValidator<T>`), DTOs, `[AstraGenerateMapping]` static partial mappers, Permission/Feature/Menu providers.
   - `Scripe.Module.{Module}.Infrastructure` — `{Module}DbContext`, `IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>`, Controllers, Seeders (`IModuleSeeder`, `IModuleDevDataSeeder`), Background Jobs (`IAutoRegisteredJob`).
2. **Result<T> Pattern Everywhere**: Never throw exceptions for business or validation errors. Always return `Result.Success(value)` or `Result.Failure<T>(Error)`.
3. **AstraFlow 2.2.0 Ecosystem Lock**: All CQRS dispatch uses `AstraFlow.Mediator` & `AstraFlow.Contracts`. All compile-time mappings use `[AstraGenerateMapping]`.
4. **Zero Cross-Module Physical Foreign Keys**: Never reference another module's Domain entity in EF Core navigation properties. Use `Guid` logical IDs + `Scripe.Core.Contracts` synchronous interfaces or asynchronous Outbox domain events.
5. **Dual-Mode Multi-Database Agnosticism**: Every module owns its schema (`identity`, `venue`, `crm`, `academy`, `billing`, etc.) and supports SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Oracle via `scripe db` CLI.

---

| **Finance** | `finance` | `src/Host/API/Controllers/` & `src/Modules/Finance/` (0 ctrls / **0 endpoints**) | `src/Modules/Finance/Finance.Application/` (15 handlers) | `src/Modules/Finance/Finance.Infrastructure/` (FinanceDbContext, SqlServerFinanceDbContext, OracleFinanceDbContext, PostgreSqlFinanceDbContext, LegacySchemaFinanceDbContext, TestFinanceDbContext) |
| **WorkManagement** | `work_management` | `src/Host/API/Controllers/` & `src/Modules/WorkManagement/` (0 ctrls / **0 endpoints**) | `src/Modules/WorkManagement/WorkManagement.Application/` (5 handlers) | `src/Modules/WorkManagement/WorkManagement.Infrastructure/` (SqlServerWorkManagementDbContext, OracleWorkManagementDbContext, PostgreSqlWorkManagementDbContext, WorkManagementDbContext) |
| **Analytics** | `analytics` | `src/Host/API/Controllers/` & `src/Modules/Analytics/` (0 ctrls / **0 endpoints**) | `src/Modules/Analytics/Analytics.Application/` (3 handlers) | `src/Modules/Analytics/Analytics.Infrastructure/` (AnalyticsDbContext, SqlServerAnalyticsDbContext, OracleAnalyticsDbContext, PostgreSqlAnalyticsDbContext) |

---

## 3. Step-by-Step Playbooks for Common Backend Tasks

### Playbook A: Adding a New Feature / Endpoint to an Existing Module
1. **Domain Layer**: Add or update entity in `Scripe.Module.{Mod}.Domain/Entities/` inheriting from `AuditableEntity`. Ensure all timestamps use `DateTime.UtcNow`.
2. **Application Layer**:
   - Create `{Action}{Entity}Command.cs` implementing `ICommand<{Entity}Response>`.
   - Create `{Action}{Entity}CommandValidator.cs` inheriting `AbstractValidator<{Action}{Entity}Command>`.
   - Create `{Action}{Entity}CommandHandler.cs` implementing `ICommandHandler<{Action}{Entity}Command, {Entity}Response>` returning `Result<{Entity}Response>`.
   - Add compile-time mapper in `{Entity}Maps.cs` with `[AstraGenerateMapping]`.
3. **Infrastructure Layer**:
   - Add `DbSet<{Entity}>` to `{Mod}DbContext.cs` and `{Entity}Configuration.cs` in `Persistence/Configurations/`.
   - Expose endpoint in `Controllers/{Entity}Controller.cs` with `[PermissionRequired(...)]`.
4. **UAT & Seeding Readiness**:
   - Register permissions in `{Mod}PermissionProvider.cs`, features/quotas in `{Mod}FeatureProvider.cs`, menus in `{Mod}MenuProvider.cs`, and seed data in `{Mod}DevDataSeeder.cs`.
5. **Verification**:
   - Run `scripe build backend`, `scripe arch-check`, and `scripe test`.

# SCRIPE-Backend — Deep-Dive Architectural & Codebase Explanation (/understand-explain)

> **Exhaustive Deep-Dive Reference** across the `Scripe.Host.API` pipeline, `Scripe.Core` kernel abstractions, **AstraFlow 2.2.0** mediator/generator mechanics, **Dual-Mode Persistence**, **Transactional Outbox/Inbox**, and **5-Layer Security**.

---

## 1. Request-to-Database Execution Trace

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Client as Client / Next.js Portal
    participant Host as Scripe.Host.API Middleware
    participant Filter as PBAC PermissionFilter
    participant Ctrl as Module API Controller
    participant Med as AstraFlow Mediator Pipeline
    participant Val as ValidationBehavior
    participant Tx as TransactionBehavior
    participant Hdl as Command/Query Handler
    participant DB as ModuleDbContext (EF Core)
    participant Outbox as OutboxProcessor Worker

    Client->>Host: HTTP Request (Bearer JWT + X-Tenant-Id)
    Host->>Host: Resolve TenantContext & User Claims
    Host->>Filter: Evaluate [PermissionRequired("module.resource.action")]
    Filter->>Ctrl: Authorized -> Invoke Action
    Ctrl->>Med: ISender.Send(ICommand<T> / IQuery<T>)
    Med->>Val: Run FluentValidation Rules
    alt Validation Fails
        Val-->>Ctrl: Result.Failure(ValidationError)
        Ctrl-->>Client: HTTP 400 / 422 ProblemDetails
    else Validation Passes
        Val->>Tx: Begin Scoped UnitOfWork / Strategy
        Tx->>Hdl: Handle(request, ct)
        Hdl->>DB: Query / Mutate Aggregate + Raise Domain Event
        DB->>DB: Intercept AuditableEntity + Serialize DomainEvent to OutboxMessages
        DB-->>Hdl: Persisted
        Hdl-->>Ctrl: Result.Success(Dto)
        Ctrl-->>Client: HTTP 200 / 201 JSON Envelope
    end
    Outbox->>DB: Poll Unprocessed OutboxMessages
    Outbox->>Med: Publish INotification to Module EventHandlers
```

---

## 2. Core Kernel Architecture (`src/Core/Scripe.Core`)

- **Total Files**: `256` | **Lines of Code**: `0`
- **Base Entities**:
  - `BaseEntity`: Provides `Guid Id` and domain event collection (`DomainEvents`, `AddDomainEvent`, `ClearDomainEvents`).

- **Result<T> Monad & Error Taxonomy**:
  - Every command/query returns `Result<T>` or `Result`.
  - Standardized error factory methods: `Error.Validation`, `Error.NotFound`, `Error.Conflict`, `Error.Forbidden`, `Error.Unauthorized`, `Error.QuotaExceeded`.
- **Cross-Module Contracts (`Scripe.Core/Contracts`)**:
  - ``

---

## 3. AstraFlow 2.2.0 In-House Framework Mechanics

1. **`AstraFlow.Contracts` & `AstraFlow.Mediator`**:

   - `885` Query Handlers (`IQueryHandler<TQuery, TResponse>`)
   - `28` Domain Event Notification Handlers (`INotificationHandler<TEvent>`)
2. **`AstraFlow.Generators` (`[AstraGenerateMapping]`)**:
   - Roslyn incremental source generator emitting zero-allocation static partial extension methods (`ToDto`, `ToListDto`) at compile time without reflection.
3. **Pipeline Behaviors**:

# SCRIPE-Backend — Complete 18-Module Business Domains & Operational Flows (/understand-domain)

> **Generated from `SCRIPE-Backend/.ua/domain-graph.json`** — **18 Business Domains**, **36 End-to-End Business Flows**, **144 Code-Anchored Execution Steps**, and **29 Cross-Domain Interactions** (`198` nodes, `209` edges).

---

## 1. All 18 Business Domains & Their Flows

### Domain: Identity: Identity, Auth & PBAC Security (`domain:identity`)

- **Summary**: Multi-tenant users, roles, PBAC permissions, JWT/Refresh tokens, sessions, OIDC/SAML/Passkey auth, and security policies. Comprises 49 domain entities, 0 HTTP endpoints, 175 commands, 117 queries, and 46 database tables in schema 'identity'.
- **Entities**: `Admin`, `Admin`, `AdminDelegation`, `AdminPasskey`, `AdminPreference`, `AdminRole`, `AdminSecurityProfile`, `AdminUserGroup`, `AdminWorkspacePin`, `DashboardPreset`, `DeviceRegistration`, `ExternalLogin`
- **Business Rules**:
  - All Identity entities inherit from AuditableEntity and enforce automatic TenantId query filtering in schema 'identity'.
  - All 175 Commands and 117 Queries execute through AstraFlow 2.2.0 and return Result<T> (zero business exceptions).
  - Cross-module communication from Identity uses logical Guid IDs, Scripe.Core Contracts, and transactional Outbox domain events.
  - All 0 HTTP endpoints in Identity enforce declarative PBAC policies via [PermissionRequired].
- **Cross-Domain Interactions**:
  - Authenticates actors and evaluates PBAC permissions via Identity & Entitlements contracts.
  - Publishes transactional Outbox domain events to Communication, Analytics, and Audit pipelines.

#### Flow: Identity Command & Transactional Write Flow (ISovereignSudoProtectedCommand) (`POST /api/v1/identity` · `http-command`)
- End-to-end transactional mutation flow for Identity: PBAC authorization -> FluentValidation -> ISovereignSudoProtectedCommandHandler -> IdentityDbContext ('identity') + Outbox event persistence.
  - **1. Controller & PBAC Guard**: Validates JWT tenant context, checks [PermissionRequired], and dispatches ISovereignSudoProtectedCommand via AstraFlow ISender. (`src/Host/API/Controllers/Identity/AccountController.cs:1-75`)
  - **2. FluentValidation Pipeline**: Executes ISovereignSudoProtectedCommandValidator rules in ValidationBehavior; returns HTTP 400/422 ProblemDetails if invalid. (`src/Modules/Identity/Identity.Application/Abstractions/ITenantPasswordValidator.cs:1-75`)
  - **3. AstraFlow CommandHandler & Domain Logic**: Invokes ISovereignSudoProtectedCommandHandler, enforces Identity aggregate invariants, and raises domain events on the entity. (`src/Modules/Identity/Identity.Application/Commands/Account/CreateAccountGovernanceActionCommandHandler.cs:1-75`)
  - **4. Schema-Isolated DbContext & Outbox Commit**: Persists entity changes and OutboxMessage atomically inside schema 'identity' via IdentityDbContext. (`src/Modules/Identity/Identity.Infrastructure/IdentityDbContextFactory.cs:1-75`)

#### Flow: Identity High-Speed Query & Projection Flow (ValidateSetupTokenQuery) (`GET /api/v1/identity` · `http-query`)
- Zero-tracking read and compile-time DTO projection flow for Identity: executes ValidateSetupTokenQueryHandler with AsNoTracking(), TenantId filter, pagination guard (<= 100), and [AstraGenerateMapping].
  - **1. Query Endpoint Dispatch**: Binds pagination/filter query parameters and sends ValidateSetupTokenQuery to the AstraFlow mediator pipeline. (`src/Host/API/Controllers/Identity/AccountController.cs:1-75`)
  - **2. AsNoTracking Tenant-Isolated Query**: Executes ValidateSetupTokenQueryHandler against IdentityDbContext with AsNoTracking() and automatic TenantId filtering. (`src/Modules/Identity/Identity.Application/Commands/Auth/GetSetupAccountCustomFieldsQueryHandler.cs:1-75`)
  - **3. Compile-Time DTO Projection ([AstraGenerateMapping])**: Maps Identity entities to response DTOs using static partial extension methods with zero reflection. (`src/Modules/Identity/Identity.Application/Users/Maps/User.cs:1-75`)
  - **4. Result<PagedResult<T>> HTTP Serialization**: Unwraps Result<T> into a standardized JSON response envelope with pagination metadata. (`src/Modules/Identity/Identity.Application/DTOs/Admin/AdminListResponse.cs:1-75`)

### Domain: Entitlements: Entitlements, Editions, Features & Quotas (`domain:entitlements`)

- **Summary**: Commercial SaaS editions, feature flags, tenant subscriptions, quota limits, usage meters, and licensing engine. Comprises 80 domain entities, 0 HTTP endpoints, 109 commands, 75 queries, and 49 database tables in schema 'entitlements'.
- **Entities**: `AnalyticsReportPreference`, `ReportCadence`, `AnalyticsSnapshot`, `BillingCycle`, `BillingCycleHelper`, `CommissionChargeAttempt`, `CommissionChargeAttemptStatus`, `CommissionLedgerStatus`, `CommissionInvoiceStatus`, `CommissionInvoice`, `CommissionInvoiceTrigger`, `CommissionLedgerEntry`
- **Business Rules**:
  - All Entitlements entities inherit from AuditableEntity and enforce automatic TenantId query filtering in schema 'entitlements'.
  - All 109 Commands and 75 Queries execute through AstraFlow 2.2.0 and return Result<T> (zero business exceptions).
  - Cross-module communication from Entitlements uses logical Guid IDs, Scripe.Core Contracts, and transactional Outbox domain events.
  - All 0 HTTP endpoints in Entitlements enforce declarative PBAC policies via [PermissionRequired].
- **Cross-Domain Interactions**:

  - Publishes transactional Outbox domain events to Communication, Analytics, and Audit pipelines.

#### Flow: Analytics Command & Transactional Write Flow (TrackEventCommand) (`POST /api/v1/analytics` · `http-command`)
- End-to-end transactional mutation flow for Analytics: PBAC authorization -> FluentValidation -> TrackEventCommandHandler -> AnalyticsDbContext ('analytics') + Outbox event persistence.
  - **1. Controller & PBAC Guard**: Validates JWT tenant context, checks [PermissionRequired], and dispatches TrackEventCommand via AstraFlow ISender. (`src/Host/API/Controllers/Analytics/AnalyticsMetricsController.cs:1-75`)
  - **2. FluentValidation Pipeline**: Executes TrackEventCommandValidator rules in ValidationBehavior; returns HTTP 400/422 ProblemDetails if invalid. (`src/Modules/Analytics/Analytics.Application/Commands/Events/TrackEventCommandValidator.cs:1-75`)
  - **3. AstraFlow CommandHandler & Domain Logic**: Invokes TrackEventCommandHandler, enforces Analytics aggregate invariants, and raises domain events on the entity. (`src/Modules/Analytics/Analytics.Application/Commands/Events/TrackEventCommandHandler.cs:1-75`)
  - **4. Schema-Isolated DbContext & Outbox Commit**: Persists entity changes and OutboxMessage atomically inside schema 'analytics' via AnalyticsDbContext. (`src/Modules/Analytics/Analytics.Infrastructure/AnalyticsDbContextFactory.cs:1-75`)

#### Flow: Analytics High-Speed Query & Projection Flow (GetAnalyticsEventsQuery) (`GET /api/v1/analytics` · `http-query`)
- Zero-tracking read and compile-time DTO projection flow for Analytics: executes GetAnalyticsEventsQueryHandler with AsNoTracking(), TenantId filter, pagination guard (<= 100), and [AstraGenerateMapping].
  - **1. Query Endpoint Dispatch**: Binds pagination/filter query parameters and sends GetAnalyticsEventsQuery to the AstraFlow mediator pipeline. (`src/Host/API/Controllers/Analytics/AnalyticsMetricsController.cs:1-75`)
  - **2. AsNoTracking Tenant-Isolated Query**: Executes GetAnalyticsEventsQueryHandler against AnalyticsDbContext with AsNoTracking() and automatic TenantId filtering. (`src/Modules/Analytics/Analytics.Application/Queries/GetAnalyticsEventsQueryHandler.cs:1-75`)
  - **3. Compile-Time DTO Projection ([AstraGenerateMapping])**: Maps Analytics entities to response DTOs using static partial extension methods with zero reflection. (`src/Host/API/Controllers/Analytics/AnalyticsMetricsController.cs:1-75`)
  - **4. Result<PagedResult<T>> HTTP Serialization**: Unwraps Result<T> into a standardized JSON response envelope with pagination metadata. (`src/Modules/Analytics/Analytics.Application/DTOs/AnalyticsDailyMetricResponse.cs:1-75`)
